📖 Game script

Baltimore comes back from Brazil with Ethan Pocic and a guard out, Ronnie Stanley questionable, Trey Hendrickson out and Zay Flowers questionable. Rain is likely for the first half (NWS 62–75%). Derrick Henry (98+ rushing, −245 to score, the shortest on the board) carries the revenge game, and Dave expects Lamar Jackson under 27.5 attempts. Tennessee scores 12.3 points a game; Cam Ward has Calvin Ridley on a MEDIUM grade and Tony Pollard (48+; PropStarz over 45.5) on the ground. The Ravens build an early lead and the Titans close the gap late. Baltimore by ten, so Tennessee covers +11.5; 42 points.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

TEN: Steve Fezzik ("best bet"), Ross Tucker (2 units) Kendra Middleton (the Ravens' long flight home and injuries) and Dave Tuley of VSiN (a best bet). BAL: Brandon Anderson (−11.5 and his contest pick), BettingPros, Sharp or Square (first half only, to avoid a second-half backdoor) and Mike Florio (Ravens 30–17). Splits: BAL has 66% of spread tickets and 71% of the money, but the TEN moneyline is a big-money flag, 4% of tickets and 19% of the money. Evan Abrams' primer has two systems on Tennessee (fading no-pedigree favorites, and fading the public after a poor offensive game), and Baltimore's starting center is out for two to three months. The line is unchanged from the Action Network open at −11.5; the total is down from 43.5 to 43. The lean is TEN +11.5, or BAL first half as Sharp or Square plays it; both fit a script where Baltimore leads early and Tennessee covers late. BettingPros (43.5) and Andrew Erickson (42.5) have the over, but with rain and a projected 42 the total is a pass. Card: the TEN moneyline (+492) is the long leg of the Slot 2 Dog-ML 2-team RR, and TEN +11.5 is a proposed SuperContest pick (both SuperContest tickets). Derrick Henry 2+ TDs is in the 8b 2+ TD 3-leg.

⚠️ What breaks it

The patched Baltimore line holds, Henry gets 30 carries and the Ravens win by 17. Ward turns it over twice (Sharp or Square calls him regressing). Flowers plays a full game and stretches the field Tennessee is trying to shrink.
